title: Engaging way to trade with AI
author: LazarB33
selftext:
Hello everyone,  
My cousin (who is a professional trader) and I have spent some time building an interactive AI trading floor that will both help you trade and make it engaging. He was working on it for some time and I made a bet with him that if I made a trailer, and post it on social media we will get some sign ups (link below).

So let me tell you more about the platform. Basically you manage your own trading floor on Wall Street full of AI agents. You have your main assistant: Taurus, that will help you with your trading performance. You can spawn trading agents that let you turn any strategy into a bot that trades for you. Our goal is to turn every possible strategy into a deterministic outcome that will be traded with pre-set rules. We made this possible by having our own script tool that allows the AI to write on it and make strategies and indicators for everything. You also have a social aspect that will allow you to either share or sell your trading agents on our marketplace. Or if you want to do trading by yourself and just use the AI as assistant, you can do that with our charting tool and add your trading setups, and let our AI be more personalised for you, by learning what type of trader you are. You also get access to our other features such as research agent that does research on strategies that will work for you or our news agent that is also personalised for you and provides you with news that will matter for you.

This is just an early preview. If you are interested consider signing up for the waitlist to get early access and test our platform. Also consider answering our questionnaire. Any feedback is appreciated! Thank you!

[https://soleatrading.com/](https://soleatrading.com/)
